settings.title: Security across the
settings.intro: From a single penetration test to fully managed detection and response, Vaultline meets you where you are and scales as your risk profile grows.

design.title: Red team & pentesting
design.text: We attack your systems the way real adversaries do — then hand you a prioritised, jargon-free report of what we found and exactly how to fix it.

design.title: Risk assessments
design.text: A structured review of your people, processes, and technology, scored against industry frameworks and aligned to your tolerance — not a generic compliance checklist.

build.title: Security architecture
build.text: Network segmentation, identity controls, and zero-trust foundations designed to blunt the impact of any single compromise.

build.title: Hardening & compliance
build.text: We close the gaps attackers actually exploit — MFA, patching, backups, and configuration — and help you demonstrate it to auditors and clients.

launch.title: Managed detection & response
launch.text: 24/7 monitoring, alert triage, and a named incident responder who picks up the phone when something goes wrong.

launch.title: Incident response
launch.text: When it's already happened, we move fast to contain, investigate, and recover — and then help you prevent the sequel.

settings.title: A process that
settings.intro: No mystery boxes, no panic-selling. Here's how a Vaultline engagement runs from first call to lasting defenses.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We interview your team, review your architecture, and map your current exposure. You get a written findings brief — whether or not you hire us.

steps.title: Prioritise
steps.text: We rank risks by likelihood and business impact, not by severity alone. You get a clear, funded roadmap of what to fix first and why.

steps.title: Remediate
steps.text: Our senior consultants close the gaps in short, visible increments alongside your team. Every change is explained and documented.

steps.title: Sustain
steps.text: We hand over monitoring, playbooks, and training so security becomes operating-as-usual. You stay resilient long after we leave.

settings.note: Every engagement ends with documentation you own and a team that understands it. We leave you stronger, not more dependent on us.

settings.title: The partner that
settings.intro: Security is full of vendors who profit from panic. We're built to be the calm, competent partner you can actually work with — here's what that means in practice.

features.title: Plain language, always
features.text: No vendor acronym soup. Every report explains risk in terms of dollars, hours, and decisions — the way your board thinks.

features.title: Independently honest
features.text: We don't sell hardware, software, or a subscription you don't need. If you already have the right tools, we say so.

features.title: Senior people only
features.text: The consultant who scopes your engagement is the one who delivers it. No bait-and-switch to juniors after you sign.

features.title: Business-aligned risk
features.text: We prioritise what actually threatens your goals — not the loudest alert. Expensive-but-redundant controls get flagged, not sold.

features.title: Your team stays capable
features.text: We bring your people along. Training and handover are core to every project, so security doesn't live in one vendor's head.

features.title: Faster than attackers
features.text: From a 48-hour containment SLA to 24/7 monitoring, we're built for speed when it matters most.

settings.title: Questions teams
settings.intro: Straight answers about independence, scope, and what working with Vaultline actually looks like.

items.question: Do you sell us software or a subscription we don't need?
items.answer: No. We're vendor-neutral and don't resell tools or take referral commissions. If you already own the right technology, we show you how to use it properly. If you genuinely need to buy something, we'll help you evaluate options on merit.

items.question: How is your work priced?
items.answer: Most assessments are fixed-scope with a clear price and defined deliverables. Managed detection and response is subscription-based. We agree the scope and success metrics up front and flag any change before spending a dollar.

items.question: We're a small team — are we really a target?
items.answer: Smaller teams are often bigger targets because attackers assume you have fewer defenses. Nearly half of all breaches hit SMBs. Our smallest clients start with a single risk assessment that shows exactly where you're exposed.

items.question: How fast can you respond to an active incident?
items.answer: We offer a 48-hour containment SLA for engagements with 24/7 monitoring, and typically reach the scene — remotely or on-site — within hours. Every managed client has a named responder they can call directly.

items.question: Will this disrupt our operations?
items.answer: We test and remediate in a way that minimises downtime. Where a fix could disrupt production, we schedule it with your team and test before, during, and after. Security shouldn't cost you your uptime.
